summary: AAR CORP filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026 announcing a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 65% of MRO Holdings, Inc. (Panama) from MROH Intermediate Holdco LLC. Consideration consists of approximately $1.819 billion cash plus 5,783.894 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock valued at $780.8 million. The deal includes an option for an additional 5% and a $22.5 million escrow for post-closing adjustments. Closing is expected in the fiscal third quarter ending February 2027, subject to regulatory approvals. The Series A preferred ranks pari passu with common stock, has no voting rights, and is convertible. Watch for regulatory approval timing and overhang from preferred conversion.
